_about: Starter catalog of widely fished patterns, hand-tagged. 'imitates' pairs a food id with how closely the fly matches it (0-1). 'sizes' are hook numbers [largest, smallest]; 0 = 1/0, -1 = 2/0, -2 = 3/0. 'proven' is a 0-1 prior for how widely the pattern is trusted. Add your own patterns in my_flies.csv rather than here. Names follow common usage so they can be matched to the flysandguides.com listing later.
